description: Developed with direct input from the Wethepeople Team, the Global Frame takes the battle-tested foundation of the Battleship and redefines it for riders who prefer a more stable Allround setup. Featuring a longer 13.5" chainstay, the Global offers increased control and precision – ideal for heavy setups, high-speed lines, and bigger transitions. Packed with the same advanced hydroformed tubing and reinforced CNC-machined dropouts as the Battleship, the Global doesn’t sacrifice strength or modern tech. It’s built to take a beating, whether you're filming clips across continents or stacking sessions at your local spot. A true team-designed Allround frame, ready for the global level. Includes Lifetime Guarantee.
